name: Erocas! ~Papakatsu Gyaru no Wana~
original_name: エロキャス！ ～パパ活ギャルの罠～
source:
The protagonist, Nogami Masato, after finishing his work for the day, was walking around the school. Then when he was about to leave, Fujimiya Haruka and Nagasawa Karen ​approached and casually talked to him.

While obliquely observing the two girls' bodies, now that he is done with Machiko, his next target would be Karen or ...Haruka... Thinking about who he would choose, at that moment, Haruka got an incoming call on her cellphone and took a glance at it. After checking it, she hurriedly put her phone away, but Masato didn't miss Haruka's facial expression that she showed for a moment. Afterwards, a little further away, Masato saw Haruka talking on her phone. It seemed like the person who she was talking to on the phone is close to her and that she was having fun.

"This time...... Ta......, Take me......Papa~"

Feeling uncomfortable with the spoiled child-like vibe from Haruka, Masato sensed something and sent Eri to investigate. And so Haruka's unexpected secret was discovered....

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1201653]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公野上正人结束了一天的工作，在学校里散步。然后，当他准备离开时，藤宫遥和长泽夏莲走近了他，并随意地与他交谈。

一边斜视着两个女孩的身体，既然已经和真智子在一起了，他的下一个目标就是凯伦或者……遥……想着自己会选择谁，就在这时，遥接到了手机来电，看了一眼。检查完后，她赶紧收起手机，但正人并没有错过遥所表现出的一瞬间的表情。随后，在稍远的地方，正人看到遥正在打电话。看起来打电话的人离她很近，而且她玩得很开心。

“这次……Ta……，带我……爸爸~”

正人对遥被宠坏的孩子般的氛围感到不舒服，他察觉到了一些事情，并派惠理去调查。就这样，遥意想不到的秘密被发现了……

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1201653]Getchu[/url]]
